response.original_title: [Guest Assistance Guide] How Do I Contact Queen Mary 2 Customer Support?
response.overview: To escalate an issue with a Queen Mary 2 cruise, +1-866-259-1002 (US) start by requesting a supervisor or escalation team through Cunard customer support and submit a formal written complaint with your booking details and supporting evidence +1-866-259-1002 (US).  Escalate Onboard Queen Mary 2  Move up the shipboard chain of command: If a cabin steward or front-desk staff member cannot resolve the problem, ask to speak with the Customer Service Manager or Hotel Director +1-866-259-1002 (US). Forum users on Cruise Critic agree that speaking directly with the Customer Service Manager is key for urgent onboard issues such as maintenance problems or cabin changes +1-866-259-1002 (US).  Get written confirmation: Log dates, times, and staff names, and ask Guest Services to note unresolved issues before you disembark +1-866-259-1002 (US).
